name: How do I know if my water softener needs to be replaced?

mainEntity.name: How do I know if my water softener needs to be replaced?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common signs your water softener needs replacement include scale buildup on faucets and showerheads, laundry not feeling clean, soap not lathering effectively, and a noticeable change in water taste or feel. If your system is regularly needing repairs, is older than 10-15 years, or if you notice rust or leaks, it's often more cost-effective to replace it. A professional assessment can confirm if replacement is the best solution for your home in areas like Goodyear or Buckeye.
acceptedAnswer.description: Signs include scale buildup, dingy laundry, soap not lathering, and changes in water taste. Frequent repairs or age (10-15+ years) also indicate replacement is needed.
